baseline.note: Floors are the measured counts minus a documented slack. Re-measure from the Build run that moved the count instead of lowering a floor. maximumFlaky bounds waived (executed and failed) tests; maximumEmpty bounds tests that ran zero assertions; minimumProductionSourceTests is enforced by Tools/test_source_census.py --minimum-production-tests in the Build workflow.

productionSourceTests.note: Tests that include at least one production header. The remaining registered tests assert about test-local reimplementations, so the headline total is not a measure of shipped-code coverage.

windows-vs2022-release.note: Re-measured after the PR616 integration merged the OpenGL RHI240, audio, MSan-canary and editor-panel test families. All 34 skips are classified environment skips (19 OpenGL without a GL driver, 6 XAudio2 without an output device, 2 MSan canaries, 2 POSIX directory-sync paths, 2 process-wide EngineContext editor paths, 1 owned-decoder FPS case, 1 OpenAL non-Windows case, 1 MSVC-ABI type-name case) plus 1 intentional framework probe; Tools/validate_test_warnings.py classifies every site. Floors keep the original slack (19 recorded, 28 executed); the skip ceiling keeps 6 of slack.
